title: No DPIA before the ANPR pilot and the Kijani Assist chatbot
condition: Neither the ANPR pilot nor the chatbot was assessed before going live. The CCTV assessment dates from 2019.
criteria: A DPIA is required before high-risk processing (Data Protection Act 2019, s.31).
cause: No DPIA procedure; projects approved by the General Manager without a data protection check.
effect: Unassessed risks to members; exposure to ODPC enforcement.
recommendation: Suspend ANPR expansion, complete DPIAs for ANPR and Kijani Assist, update the CCTV assessment, and require a DPIA before approving any new processing.

title: Processor contracts lack data protection and transfer terms
condition: No data processing agreement with Sauti AI Labs. The FairwayOne contract has no safeguards for hosting member data in South Africa.
criteria: Processors need written contracts; transfers outside Kenya need safeguards (Data Protection Act 2019, s.48 and s.49).
cause: Contracts signed by department heads without a data protection review.
effect: Member data processed abroad and by an AI vendor without agreed protections.
recommendation: Sign data processing agreements with Sauti AI Labs and FairwayOne including transfer safeguards; add a data protection review to the contract approval step.

title: No breach response procedure or breach log
condition: There is no written procedure or log. Staff interviewed did not know who to tell about a breach.
criteria: Breaches must be notified to the ODPC within 72 hours (Data Protection Act 2019, s.43).
cause: Incident handling left to the ICT support firm without a Club procedure.
effect: A breach could go unreported past the 72-hour deadline.
recommendation: Approve a breach response procedure with a 72-hour clock, a breach log and named contacts; brief all managers.

title: No record of processing activities
condition: The Club has no list of what personal data it processes, why, and on what lawful basis.
criteria: Processing must have a lawful basis and follow the data protection principles (Data Protection Act 2019, s.25 and s.30).
cause: Not assigned to anyone when the DPO was designated.
effect: The Club cannot show that each use of data is lawful.
recommendation: Build a record of processing activities, starting with membership, CCTV, ANPR, the chatbot and payroll.

title: Privacy notice gaps
condition: 3 of 8 entry points have no CCTV sign. The member app and the chatbot show no privacy notice.
criteria: People must be told how their data is used (Data Protection Act 2019, s.29).
cause: Notices were written for the website only.
effect: Members and visitors are not told how their data is used in these channels.
recommendation: Install signs at the 3 entry points; add the privacy notice to the app and to the chatbot's first message.

title: Data subject requests not logged; some answered late
condition: 2 of 6 requests in the last 12 months were answered after the prescribed period. No request log exists.
criteria: Requests must be answered within the prescribed time (Data Protection Act 2019, s.26).
cause: Requests arrive through several departments with no central owner.
effect: Complaints to the ODPC; members' rights not respected.
recommendation: Route all requests to the DPO, keep a request log with deadlines, and report it monthly.

title: No retention schedule
condition: No retention schedule exists. CCTV footage is kept for 180 days and former members' files go back to 2015.
criteria: Data must not be kept longer than necessary (Data Protection Act 2019, s.39).
cause: Systems keep data by default; nobody owns disposal.
effect: More data at risk in a breach; breach of the storage limitation principle.
recommendation: Approve a retention schedule, set CCTV retention to a justified period, and run the first disposal.

title: WhatsApp promotions without an opt-out
condition: 8 of 20 sampled promotional messages, all on WhatsApp, had no opt-out.
criteria: Marketing needs consent or a working opt-out (Data Protection Act 2019, s.37).
cause: The WhatsApp template was set up without the opt-out line.
effect: Complaints from members who do not want promotions.
recommendation: Add an opt-out line to the WhatsApp template and honour opt-outs within 48 hours.

title: Gifts register not kept up; no confidential reporting channel
condition: The gifts and hospitality register has no entries since March 2026. There is no confidential way to report concerns.
criteria: The Club must have procedures to prevent bribery and report suspicions (Bribery Act 2016, s.9 and s.14).
cause: The register is not part of the procurement process; no reporting channel was set up.
effect: Bribery in procurement could go undetected or unreported.
recommendation: Make the register part of every purchase above a set value and set up a confidential reporting email and phone line.

title: Personnel files without signed contracts
condition: 4 of 25 sampled personnel files have no signed employment contract.
criteria: Employees must have written contracts (Employment Act 2007, s.9 and s.10).
cause: Contracts for seasonal grounds staff were not returned after signing.
effect: Disputes over terms; exposure in employment claims.
recommendation: Obtain signed contracts for the 4 employees, then check all seasonal staff files.

title: No fire drill in 14 months
condition: The fire audit was done, but the last fire drill was 14 months ago.
criteria: Fire drills and an annual fire safety audit are required (Fire Risk Reduction Rules 2007).
cause: Drills were postponed because of events at the clubhouse.
effect: Staff may not evacuate members and guests safely during a large event.
recommendation: Hold a fire drill within 30 days and schedule drills in the compliance calendar.

title: Safety committee meetings and one risk assessment missing
condition: The safety committee met in 2 of the last 4 quarters. There is no risk assessment for the maintenance workshop.
criteria: A safety committee and workplace risk assessments are required (OSHA 2007, s.9 and s.6).
cause: No standing meeting dates; the workshop was missed when assessments were updated.
effect: Hazards in the workshop may not be controlled.
recommendation: Set quarterly committee dates for the year and complete the workshop risk assessment.

title: Liquor licence renewed late
condition: The liquor licence was renewed 9 days after it expired in June 2026. Renewal dates are kept in personal calendars.
criteria: A current liquor licence is required to sell alcohol (county alcoholic drinks control law).
cause: No shared licence register with reminders.
effect: Fines or closure of the bars; reputational damage.
recommendation: Move all licence dates into the compliance calendar with 60-day reminders to two people.

title: Expired food handlers' medical certificates
condition: 6 of 30 food handlers have expired medical certificates.
criteria: Food handlers must hold current medical certificates (Public Health Act).
effect: Public health risk and possible closure of the kitchen on inspection.
recommendation: Renew the 6 certificates now and add certificate expiry dates to the compliance calendar.

title: Pesticides recorded without registration numbers
condition: 3 of 12 products in the pesticide register have no registration number.
criteria: Only registered pest control products may be used (Pest Control Products Act).
cause: The register does not require the number at purchase.
effect: Possible use of unregistered products on the course.
recommendation: Check the 3 products, stop using any that are unregistered, and make the number a required field.

title: No regulatory change log
condition: There is no log of regulatory changes; changes are picked up informally.
criteria: The Club's regulatory change-monitoring procedure requires a log and quarterly reporting.
cause: The procedure has not been started.
effect: New legal duties may be missed.
recommendation: Start the regulatory change log and report it to the Finance and Audit sub-committee each quarter.
